name: Nishikatsura (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Nishikatsura town emblem in white: an outlined hexagonal device enclosing a stylised letter W.
history: Municipal flag of Nishikatsura, a town in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Nishikatsura town emblem — an outlined hexagonal device enclosing a stylised letter W
